0.original: Ryne seems troubled by the sight of you.

24.original: Speak with Y'shtola at the Crystarium.

25.original: Speak with the manager of suites in the Pendants.

48.original: The end to Light's dominion over this world is fast at hand.

49.original: When all of this is over, it would mean a lot to me if we could go and visit Tesleen's grave together. I have such a lot to tell her...

50.original: Perhaps their ministrations were not as thorough as I thought. Or perhaps I was a touch too reckless.

51.original: Once more shall the night share equal dominion over the firmament.<hex:02100103>And yet our travails are far from over...

52.original: Is this not the moment Emet-Selch usually chooses to descend upon us? Whatever will we do without his feigned praise and backhanded compliments?

53.original: Are you feeling all right, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? After you defeated the Lightwarden, I could swear I saw its aether─

54.original: Uh...never mind. I'm still getting used to my powers. It's probably nothing.

55.original: I'm just relieved I was right about where the Warden was hiding.

56.original: The last one is hiding in Kholusia, isn't it? I can't feel it from here, believe it or not...

57.original: But perhaps we should head back to the Crystarium first. We have a lot to tell the Exarch...and I think we could all do with some rest.

59.original: Y'shtola said she needed to speak with us. It sounded rather urgent.

60.original: The others are with the Exarch. Before we join them, there is something I wish to confirm.

61.original: Tell me, Ryne─have you noticed anything peculiar about <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s appearance of late? Anything at all? Speak freely. <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> won't mind.

62.original: Well...since Minfilia bequeathed her power to me, I've been able to see the Light inside <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>...though I didn't think anything of it at first. But after we defeated the Warden in Amh Araeng, I realized something was wrong.

63.original: You've absorbed its aether, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. And the Light within you has grown monstrous.

64.original: Then it is as I suspected.

67.original: If naught is done, this will only get worse.

68.original: Ryne─with the power of the Oracle, you have gained some measure of control over Light, have you not? Is there anything you can do for <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>?

69.original: Extinguishing it is out of the question. Even at her strongest, Minfilia could only hold back the Light.

70.original: I <hex:021A020203>might<hex:021A020103> be able to suppress it...but I don't know for how long.

71.original: Then we have no choice but to rely on Urianger and his secrets.

72.original: If the next battle is to be the last, you may yet be able to play your part. But you will need all of your strength.

73.original: I will discuss strategy with the others and see that everything is made ready for our departure. You are to return to your chambers and rest until then. Understood?

78.original: Good. Whether you want it or not, you have most certainly earned some respite.

79.original: This is not the time for false bravado. Should your condition worsen, it could have dire consequences for us all.

80.original: Now please, return to your chambers and rest.

81.original: Hah. None of that cheek, or I will take you across my knee.

82.original: Now, off with you to the Pendants. We will call for you when the time comes.

83.original: Is everything all right, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>? You don't seem quite yourself.

84.original: Perhaps a hot meal and a freshly made bed will improve matters. Your room is ready, if you'd care to retire?

86.original: Very good. If you should have need of anything─anything at all─pray do not hesitate to call.

88.original: It would need to be later. After the liberation of Ala Mhigo, perhaps...

90.original: We have to go. They'll be upon us any moment.

91.original: Very well. Where to next, then?

92.original: Let's just worry about getting out of the city, and pray the airship is still in one piece.

93.original: Anywhere we go from here will just be more of the same.

94.original: Gods. By the sound of that last one, I reckon the knights twelve might be the knights' rubble now.

95.original: Is there nothing else we can do?

96.original: Do? Look around you─this isn't war.

97.original: It's a sickness, and it's spread to every corner of Eorzea. The city-states are in disarray, and by all accounts the Far East's faring no better.

98.original: There'll be nothing left of us when this is over.

100.original: I never tire of that story. When the hero swoops in astride a white dragon to save the little girl...

101.original: I could die happy knowing someone like that was still around.

102.original: Indeed. But not today. Not while our message remains undelivered.

103.original: Have faith, my friend: we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> find <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>...
